letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai or the gentle monsoon breezes in Ahmedabad reminds me how lucky I am to share this beautiful chaos with you. Your smile lights up my days like the Burj Khalifa at night, and your love steadies me like the Sabarmati’s calm flow. I cherish our weekend brunches, our spontaneous desert drives, and the way you call me “cutie” when I steal the last samosa. Here’s to countless more adventures together, hand in hand, heart to heart.
poem:
In dunes or by the river’s sigh,  
Your laugh’s the spark that lights my sky.  
Across the miles, our love’s a song,  
Together, jaan, we both belong.
